package com.zulrahhelper.points;

import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;

@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Getter
public enum StandLocation
{

	START(19, 52),
	START_MAGMA(11, 43),
	MELEE_START_MAGMA(9, 47),
	PILLAR_1_SOUTH(20, 23),
	PILLAR_1_WEST(18, 16),
	MELEE_PILLAR_1_WEST(9, 32),
	PILLAR_1_NORTH(26, 9),
	MELEE_PILLAR_1_NORTH(29, 5),
	NORTH(41, 10),
	PILLAR_2_SOUTH(62, 23),
	PILLAR_2_EAST(63, 16),
	MELEE_PILLAR_2_EAST(69, 30),
	PILLAR_2_NORTH(55, 9),
	MELEE_PILLAR_2_NORTH(49, 5);

	private final int x;
	private final int y;
}

package com.zulrahhelper.tree;

import com.google.common.collect.Iterables;
import com.zulrahhelper.options.Prayer;
import com.zulrahhelper.points.StandLocation;
import com.zulrahhelper.options.ZulrahForm;
import com.zulrahhelper.options.ZulrahLocation;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.inject.Inject;
import javax.inject.Singleton;
import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.NonNull;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;

import static com.zulrahhelper.options.Strategy.MELEE_ONLY;
import static com.zulrahhelper.points.Point.path;
import static com.zulrahhelper.points.Point.stand;

@Singleton
@Slf4j
public class PatternTree
{
	protected Node root;

	@Getter
	@NonNull
	protected Node state;

	@Inject
	public PatternTree()
	{
		this.root = build();
		this.state = root;
	}

	public Node find(Step value)
	{
		return root.find(value);
	}

	public void setState(@Nonnull Node n)
	{
		if (contains(n))
		{
			state = n;
		}
	}

	public boolean contains(Node node)
	{
		return root.find(node);
	}

	public void reset()
	{
		state = root;
	}

	public int depth(Node node)
	{
		return depth(node.getValue());
	}

	public int depth(Step value)
	{
		Node node = find(value);
		if (node == null)
		{
			return -1;
		}

		int i = 0;
		while (node.parent != null)
		{
			i++;
			node = node.parent;
		}

		return i;
	}

	public List<Node> buildPath()
	{
		return buildPath(state);
	}

	public List<Node> buildPath(Node n)
	{
		List<Node> path = new ArrayList<>();
		if (n.getParent() != null)
		{
			var p = n.getParent();
			while (p != null)
			{
				path.add(0, Node.of(p));
				p = p.getParent();
			}
		}

		path.add(Node.of(n));
		var nc = n.getChildren();
		while (!nc.isEmpty())
		{
			if (nc.size() > 1)
			{
				Iterables.getLast(path)
					.children.addAll(nc.stream()
						.map(Node::of)
						.collect(Collectors.toList()));
				break;
			}
			else
			{
				path.add(Node.of(nc.get(0)));
			}

			nc = nc.get(0).getChildren();
		}

		return path;
	}

	private static Node build()
	{
		return Node.builder()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.title("START")
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START))
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.attacks(5)
				.venom(4)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.child(buildMelee())
			.child(buildRange())
			.child(buildMage())
			.build();
	}

	private static Node buildMelee()
	{
		return Node.builder()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.title("MAGMA")
				.form(ZulrahForm.MELEE)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START))
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START_MAGMA))
				.attacks(2)
				.point(path(MELEE_ONLY).at(StandLocation.START).to(StandLocation.MELEE_START_MAGMA))
				.build())
			.child(Node.builder()
				.value(Step.builder()
					.form(ZulrahForm.MAGE)
					.prayer(Prayer.MAGIC)
					.attacks(4)
					.point(stand(StandLocation.START))
					.point(path(MELEE_ONLY).at(StandLocation.START).to(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH))
					.build())
				.child(buildMeleeA())
				.child(buildMeleeB())
				.build())
			.build();
	}

	private static Node buildMeleeA()
	{
		return Node.builder()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.title("MAGMA A")
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.NORTH)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.prayer(Prayer.RANGE)
				.attacks(5)
				.venom(2)
				.snakelings(2)
				.point(path(MELEE_ONLY).at(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_1_NORTH).to(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_2_NORTH).to(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.form(ZulrahForm.MELEE)
				.attacks(2)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.form(ZulrahForm.MAGE)
				.attacks(5)
				.prayer(Prayer.MAGIC)
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.EAST)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.NORTH))
				.point(stand(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_2_EAST, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.NORTH)
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.venom(3)
				.snakelings(2)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH))
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.NORTH)
				.form(ZulrahForm.MAGE)
				.attacks(5)
				.venom(2)
				.snakelings(2)
				.prayer(Prayer.MAGIC)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH))
				.point(path(MELEE_ONLY).at(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH).to(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_1_NORTH).to(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_2_NORTH).to(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.EAST)
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.attacks(10)
				.venom(4)
				.prayer(Prayer.RANGE)
				.prayer(Prayer.MAGIC)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.point(stand(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_2_EAST, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.form(ZulrahForm.MELEE)
				.attacks(2)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START))
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START_MAGMA))
				.point(path(MELEE_ONLY).at(StandLocation.START).to(StandLocation.MELEE_START_MAGMA))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.title("RESET")
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.prayer(Prayer.RANGE)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START))
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.attacks(5)
				.venom(4)
				.reset(true)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.buildUp();
	}

	private static Node buildMeleeB()

			.value(Step.builder()
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.NORTH)

				.venom(2)
				.snakelings(2)
				.prayer(Prayer.MAGIC)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.point(path(MELEE_ONLY).at(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_2_NORTH).to(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.form(ZulrahForm.MELEE)
				.attacks(2)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.WEST)
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.attacks(5)
				.prayer(Prayer.RANGE)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.NORTH))
				.point(stand(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_1_WEST, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.NORTH)
				.form(ZulrahForm.MAGE)
				.attacks(5)
				.venom(2)
				.snakelings(2)
				.prayer(Prayer.MAGIC)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.point(path(MELEE_ONLY).at(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_1_NORTH).to(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_2_NORTH).to(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.EAST)
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.attacks(10)
				.venom(4)
				.prayer(Prayer.RANGE)
				.prayer(Prayer.MAGIC)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.point(stand(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_2_EAST, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.form(ZulrahForm.MELEE)
				.attacks(2)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START))
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START_MAGMA))
				.point(path(MELEE_ONLY).at(StandLocation.START).to(StandLocation.MELEE_START_MAGMA))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.title("RESET")
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.prayer(Prayer.RANGE)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START))
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.attacks(5)
				.venom(4)
				.reset(true)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.buildUp();
	}

	private static Node buildRange()

		return Node.builder()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.title("SERP")
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.WEST)

				.prayer(Prayer.RANGE)
				.attacks(5)
				.snakelings(2)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.MELEE_START_MAGMA, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.form(ZulrahForm.MELEE)

				.venom(3)
				.snakelings(2)

				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH, MELEE_ONLY))

			.value(Step.builder()

				.attacks(5)

				.point(stand(StandLocation.NORTH))
				.point(path(MELEE_ONLY).at(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_2_NORTH).to(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_1_NORTH))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.WEST)
				.form(ZulrahForm.MAGE)
				.attacks(5)
				.prayer(Prayer.MAGIC)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.NORTH))
				.point(stand(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_1_WEST, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.venom(3)
				.snakelings(2)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.EAST)
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.attacks(5)
				.prayer(Prayer.RANGE)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.point(stand(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_2_EAST, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())

			.value(Step.builder()

				.attacks(5)

				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.WEST)
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.attacks(10)
				.prayer(Prayer.MAGIC)
				.prayer(Prayer.RANGE)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH))
				.point(stand(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_1_WEST, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.form(ZulrahForm.MAGE)
				.snakelings(2)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START))
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.title("RESET")
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.prayer(Prayer.RANGE)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START))
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.attacks(5)
				.venom(4)
				.reset(true)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.buildUp();
	}

	private static Node buildMage()
	{
		return Node.builder()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.title("TANZ")
				.form(ZulrahForm.MAGE)
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.WEST)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START))
				.prayer(Prayer.MAGIC)
				.attacks(6)
				.snakelings(2)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.MELEE_START_MAGMA, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.NORTH)
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.attacks(4)
				.venom(2)
				.prayer(Prayer.RANGE)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.point(path(MELEE_ONLY).at(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_1_NORTH).to(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_2_NORTH).to(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.EAST)
				.form(ZulrahForm.MAGE)
				.prayer(Prayer.MAGIC)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.attacks(4)
				.snakelings(2)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_2_EAST, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.form(ZulrahForm.MELEE)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH))
				.attacks(2)
				.venom(2)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.WEST)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH))
				.prayer(Prayer.RANGE)
				.attacks(4)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_1_WEST, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())

				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.NORTH)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH))
				.snakelings(2)
				.venom(3)
				.point(path(MELEE_ONLY).at(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH).to(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_1_NORTH).to(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_2_NORTH).to(StandLocation.PILLAR_2_SOUTH))
				.build())

			.value(Step.builder()

				.form(ZulrahForm.MAGE)

				.attacks(5)
				.venom(4)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_2_EAST, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.prayer(Prayer.RANGE)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH))
				.attacks(5)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.form(ZulrahForm.MAGE)
				.prayer(Prayer.MAGIC)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH))
				.attacks(4)
				.venom(3)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.spawn(ZulrahLocation.WEST)
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.prayer(Prayer.MAGIC)
				.prayer(Prayer.RANGE)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.PILLAR_1_SOUTH))
				.attacks(8)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.MELEE_PILLAR_1_WEST, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.form(ZulrahForm.MAGE)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START))
				.snakelings(2)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START, MELEE_ONLY))
				.build())
			.node()
			.value(Step.builder()
				.title("RESET")
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.prayer(Prayer.RANGE)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START))
				.form(ZulrahForm.RANGE)
				.attacks(5)
				.venom(4)
				.reset(true)
				.point(stand(StandLocation.START, MELEE_ONLY))

}
